deployment: PUBLIC DEMO · GitHub Pages + browser worker + IndexedDB · no hosted API

components.label: Public banking application
components.purpose: Role-aware customer, business, operations, analytics and engineering journeys.
components.tradeoff: Browser-local role simulation; visitors control their own data and code.

components.label: Browser command engine
components.purpose: Validate exact CAD amounts, ownership, approvals and idempotent commands.
components.inputs: OIDC-bound customer scenario or local persona; opaque session; CSRF; idempotency key
components.outputs: Atomic payment, ledger and outbox writes
components.tradeoff: Simulation rules, not server authentication. PostgreSQL backend remains separately runnable.

components.label: IndexedDB journal store
components.purpose: Persist atomic account, journal, command and event state in this browser.
components.outputs: Booked account state and source events
components.tradeoff: Whole-state optimistic revision check in a read/write transaction. Bounded scenario, no server or cross-device storage.

components.label: Transactional outbox
components.purpose: Persist payment snapshot events with the same IndexedDB financial commit.
components.tradeoff: Same logical event grain as the core; source_system identifies the browser simulation.

components.label: Browser Web Worker
components.purpose: Process preserved events off the UI thread; resume backlog after reopening.
components.tradeoff: Runs only while a page is open. Multiple tabs use atomic compare-and-set revisions.

components.label: Bronze event archive
components.purpose: Preserve envelopes, SHA-256 checksums, source sequence, receipt and run IDs.
components.tradeoff: Browser storage prototype, not Delta. Archive commit precedes acknowledgement.

components.label: Silver projections
components.purpose: Verify event identity, checksum, version completeness and current operational state.
components.outputs: Current payment snapshots and preserved history
components.tradeoff: Current projections and archived history are distinct. Full bounded replay.

components.label: Gold publication
components.purpose: Publish daily instruction and return activity after source and financial controls.
components.outputs: Version, cutoff, refresh time and daily facts
components.tradeoff: Atomic last-good pointer. A failed refresh leaves existing results available and stale.

components.label: Approved scenario views
components.purpose: Show role-appropriate analytical outputs and actual scenario freshness.
components.tradeoff: Public browser controls are educational, not a security boundary against the device owner.

components.label: Debezium → Kafka
components.purpose: Future CDC/streaming profile, introduced through a single-publisher cutover.
components.tradeoff: Replication lag and retained WAL growth need tested alerts and recovery.

components.label: Spark + Delta Lake
components.purpose: Target medallion lakehouse on durable object storage.
components.tradeoff: Java, Spark and object storage exceed the basic profile. Compatibility is reviewed before pinning.

components.label: Airflow orchestration
components.purpose: Schedule dependent batch, reconciliation and bounded backfill jobs.
components.tradeoff: Omitted while one durable worker owns the single pipeline; no competing scheduler.

connections.semantics: Business records, journals and outbox commit or roll back together.

At least once. Archive commit precedes acknowledgement; duplicates are expected.

connections.contract: Original envelope + source sequence + receipt + run
connections.semantics: Unique event identity; changed identity content is rejected.

connections.contract: Strict v1; source identity and financial controls
connections.semantics: History is retained; highest version wins; no incomplete publication.

connections.contract: Day × WEB × CAD; source cutoff and checksums
connections.semantics: Failed refresh leaves the prior publication pointer unchanged.

connections.contract: Publication ID, cutoff, refreshed_at, daily and totals
connections.semantics: Eventual consistency with explicit staleness; not a spending authority.

connections.contract: Same event identity; one publisher at cutover
connections.semantics: Planned; no CDC/node-failure claim in this release.
Planned; idempotency still required at each sink.

connections.contract: Bounded input, run identity and publication gate
connections.semantics: Planned; orchestration owns schedules, Spark owns transformations.
